title: Depth bounded by the canonical block tree
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates, and let $\rho$ assign to each coordinate whether it is free or fixed to one of the two signs. The decision-tree depth of the Boolean function obtained by restricting $\varphi$ according to $\rho$ is at most the depth of the canonical block tree of $\varphi$ for $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates
$\rho$ is a coordinate restriction on the $n$ coordinates
